title: NIST SP 800-171 Revision 2: protecting CUI in nonfederal systems (the 110 requirements of CMMC Level 2)

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other systems).

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Limit system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with applicable CUI rules.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays to prevent access and viewing of data after a period of inactivity.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Terminate (automatically) a user session after a defined condition.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Route remote access via managed access control points.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Authorize remote execution of privileged commands and remote access to security-relevant information.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing such connections.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Protect wireless access using authentication and encryption.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Control connection of mobile devices.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Encrypt CUI on mobile devices and mobile computing platforms.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Verify and control/limit connections to and use of external systems.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Limit use of portable storage devices on external systems.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.statement: Control CUI posted or processed on publicly accessible systems.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.statement: Ensure that managers, systems administrators, and users of organizational systems are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities and of the applicable policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of those systems.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.statement: Ensure that personnel are trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties and responsibilities.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.statement: Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users, so they can be held accountable for their actions.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Review and update logged events.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Correlate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Provide audit record reduction and report generation to support on-demand analysis and reporting.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Provide a system capability that compares and synchronizes internal system clocks with an authoritative source to generate time stamps for audit records.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability
controls.statement: Limit management of audit logging functionality to a subset of privileged users.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems (including hardware, software, firmware, and documentation) throughout the respective system development life cycles.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Track, review, approve or disapprove, and log changes to organizational systems.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Analyze the security impact of changes prior to implementation.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to organizational systems.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Employ the principle of least functionality by configuring organizational systems to provide only essential capabilities.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Restrict, disable, or prevent the use of nonessential programs, functions, ports, protocols, and services.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Apply deny-by-exception (blacklisting) policy to prevent the use of unauthorized software or deny-all, permit-by-exception (whitelisting) policy to allow the execution of authorized software.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Control and monitor user-installed software.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Identify system users, processes acting on behalf of users, and devices.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational systems.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non- privileged accounts.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Disable identifiers after a defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Allow temporary password use for system logons with an immediate change to a permanent password.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Store and transmit only cryptographically-protected passwords.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.statement: Obscure feedback of authentication information.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.statement: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.statement: Track, document, and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.statement: Test the organizational incident response capability.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.statement: Perform maintenance on organizational systems.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.statement: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel used to conduct system maintenance.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.statement: Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any CUI.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.statement: Check media containing diagnostic and test programs for malicious code before the media are used in organizational systems.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.statement: Require multifactor authentication to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions via external network connections and terminate such connections when nonlocal maintenance is complete.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.statement: Supervise the maintenance activities of maintenance personnel without required access authorization.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Protect (i.e., physically control and securely store) system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Sanitize or destroy system media containing CUI before disposal or release for reuse.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Control access to media containing CUI and maintain accountability for media during transport outside of controlled areas.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of CUI stored on digital media during transport unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Control the use of removable media on system components.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Prohibit the use of portable storage devices when such devices have no identifiable owner.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.statement: Protect the confidentiality of backup CUI at storage locations.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.statement: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing CUI.

controls.title: Personnel Security
controls.statement: Ensure that organizational systems containing CUI are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.statement: Limit physical access to organizational systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.statement: Protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure for organizational systems.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.statement: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.statement: Maintain audit logs of physical access.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.statement: Control and manage physical access devices.

controls.title: Physical Protection
controls.statement: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.statement: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations (including mission, functions, image, or reputation), organizational assets, and individuals, resulting from the operation of organizational systems and the associated processing, storage, or transmission of CUI.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.statement: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.statement: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments.

controls.title: Security Assessment
controls.statement: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective in their application.

controls.title: Security Assessment
controls.statement: Develop and implement plans of action designed to correct deficiencies and reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities in organizational systems.

controls.title: Security Assessment
controls.statement: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis to ensure the continued effectiveness of the controls.

controls.title: Security Assessment
controls.statement: Develop, document, and periodically update system security plans that describe system boundaries, system environments of operation, how security requirements are implemented, and the relationships with or connections to other systems.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Monitor, control, and protect communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Employ architectural designs, software development techniques, and systems engineering principles that promote effective information security within organizational systems.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Separate user functionality from system management functionality.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception (i.e., deny all, permit by exception).

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Prevent remote devices from simultaneously establishing non-remote connections with organizational systems and communicating via some other connection to resources in external networks (i.e., split tunneling).

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Terminate network connections associated with communications sessions at the end of the sessions or after a defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and provide indication of devices in use to users present at the device.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Control and monitor the use of mobile code.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Control and monitor the use of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) technologies.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection
controls.statement: Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.statement: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.statement: Provide protection from malicious code at designated locations within organizational systems.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.statement: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.statement: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.statement: Perform periodic scans of organizational systems and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.statement: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity
controls.statement: Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems.
